steps.npc: I'm working. What do you have to say that's so urgent?

options.text: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?

steps.player: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?

steps.npc: There's a lot of space here. More open space than back home.
Pollnivneach. It's a town to the south of the Shantay Pass.

options.text: So, what do you do here?

steps.player: So, what do you do here?

steps.npc: I'm on guard duty. Making sure nobody tries to steal anything from the house and tents in the middle of town.

steps.player: Why are you only guarding those buildings?

steps.npc: That's all I've been hired to guard.

options.text: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
options.condition: If the player has asked any of the Al Kharid merchants about Ali Morrisane:

steps.player: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...

steps.npc: Yeah, he hired me. He owns this house and these two tents, too.
It pays better than back home.

steps.player: Why, what did you do back home?

steps.npc: But Ali Morrisane pays us well, at least.

steps.player: Maybe I should talk to him...

steps.npc: Why not? He always likes to meet potential business partners.

options.text: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
options.condition: If the player has asked Ellis, the Shop assistant, or the Shop keeper (possibly other Al Kharid merchants as well) about Ali Morrisane:

steps.player: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
You're not going to deny it?

steps.npc: Why bother? None of them can fight back, after all.
